detailed_description: This QR Code Generator creates ISO/IEC 18004-compliant QR codes by converting input data into a 2D matrix barcode using Reed-Solomon error correction algorithms. The tool supports multiple encoding modes including numeric, alphanumeric, byte/binary, and Kanji character sets. Users can generate high-contrast codes with error correction levels L (7%), M (15%), Q (25%), or H (30%) to withstand physical damage. The generator implements the JIS X 0510 standard for module arrangement, applying optimal masking patterns to minimize optical scanning errors. Technical professionals benefit from the ability to specify exact module sizes (1-50 pixels) and inversion options for dark/light color swaps. Unlike basic generators, this tool provides hex color customization for both foreground and background with alpha transparency support, ensuring compatibility with CMYK offset printing requirements. The resulting PNG-24 output preserves full color fidelity and transparency layers for seamless integration into digital workflows.
usage_steps: 1. Choose 'Text' or 'URL' input mode using the toggle switch
2. Enter data in the UTF-8 encoded text area, supporting up to 2953 bytes
3. Select error correction level from the dropdown (L/M/Q/H)
4. Adjust module size slider (1-50 pixels) and enable inversion checkbox
5. Click 'Preview' to validate alignment patterns and quiet zone margins
6. Download the generated QR code as PNG-24 with embedded metadata
usage_examples: Marketing teams creating scannable campaign assets with embedded UTM tracking parameters
Manufacturers embedding product specifications in maintenance documentation QR codes
Event organizers generating ticket QR codes with inverted colors for night-time scanning
Developers testing error correction capabilities by deliberately damaging generated codes
